skill.name: docx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, and verify Microsoft Word .docx files using OOXML, docx-js guidance, tracked changes, and comments.
skill.summary: Work with Word documents through structured creation, OOXML editing, tracked changes, comments, and validation workflows.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: No evidence of malicious intent, prompt injection, credential theft, or network exfiltration was found. The confirmed risks are unsafe ZIP extraction of untrusted Office files and privileged or global dependency installation instructions. Most static matches are benign OOXML schemas, namespace URLs, Markdown examples, local temporary files, or fixed validation commands. Static review was capped at 400/450 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 50 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.
Replace every extractall call with safe member extraction that rejects absolute paths, drive prefixes, symlinks, and parent traversal.
Remove sudo apt-get commands from automated skill guidance, or require explicit user approval before any privileged installation.
Avoid npm global installs in agent workflows, or pin versions and install inside a project-local or sandboxed environment.
Run LibreOffice, Pandoc, and Poppler conversions in a sandbox when processing documents from unknown sources.

content.user_title: Edit Word Documents with Tracked Changes
content.value_statement: Word document edits can break formatting, comments, and review history. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured DOCX workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates new DOCX files with docx-js patterns and formatting guidance.
Extracts document text and review markup with Pandoc workflows.
Unpacks DOCX files for direct OOXML inspection and repair.
Adds tracked changes and comments through the bundled Python document library.
Validates XML structure, relationships, content types, and tracked change rules.
Converts DOCX pages to PDF or images for visual review.
limitations: Requires external tools such as Pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, Python, and Node.js.
Works on local files and may create temporary or output document files.
Complex Word features may need manual OOXML inspection before editing.
Untrusted DOCX files should be handled in a sandbox until ZIP extraction is hardened.

use_cases.title: Review Legal Drafts
use_cases.description: Apply precise tracked changes and explanatory comments while preserving reviewer visibility.

use_cases.title: Prepare Business Documents
use_cases.description: Create formatted Word files with headings, tables, images, and professional layout rules.

use_cases.title: Inspect Broken DOCX Files
use_cases.description: Unpack document packages, inspect OOXML relationships, and validate repaired files before delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Word Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX file from this outline. Use clear headings, readable spacing, and a professional table where needed.

prompt_templates.title: Extract and Summarize
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this DOCX file, preserve visible tracked changes, and summarize the main points and review issues.

prompt_templates.title: Edit with Review Markup
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this DOCX file with tracked changes. Add comments where the reason for each change may not be obvious.

prompt_templates.title: Repair OOXML Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the unpacked DOCX package, identify relationship or XML problems, repair them, and validate the final document.

output_examples.input: Revise a contract so payment terms change from 30 days to 60 days.
output_examples.output: The document includes tracked replacements for the affected terms and comments explaining the business reason for each change.

output_examples.input: Create a project brief with a summary, milestones, and an approval table.
output_examples.output: The generated Word file contains structured headings, a milestone table, consistent spacing, and document metadata ready for review.

output_examples.input: Check why a DOCX file reports broken relationships after an image edit.
output_examples.output: The review identifies the missing image relationship, updates content references, and validates that the repaired package opens correctly.

best_practices: Use tracked changes for documents owned by another person or organization.
Verify edits by converting the final DOCX to readable text before delivery.
Keep each edit batch small when modifying complex legal or business documents.
anti_patterns: Do not replace whole paragraphs when only a few words changed.
Do not edit another author's tracked changes without preserving review history.
Do not process untrusted DOCX archives outside a sandboxed workspace.

faq.question: Can this skill create new Word documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides docx-js guidance for structured DOCX generation with headings, tables, images, and formatting.

faq.question: Can it edit existing DOCX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports OOXML editing and a Python document library for comments and tracked changes.

faq.question: Does it preserve tracked changes?
faq.answer: It is designed to create and verify tracked changes, especially for review-heavy documents.

faq.question: What tools does it require?
faq.answer: Common workflows use Python, Node.js, Pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, and defusedxml.

faq.question: Can it inspect document internals?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to unpack DOCX files and inspect XML, relationships, media, comments, and metadata.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted DOCX files?
faq.answer: Use a sandbox for untrusted files. The bundled extraction scripts need path validation before broad deployment.
